name: Mekia Cox
biography: Mekia Cox is an actress, singer and dancer. She was a dancer in the Michael Jackson concert series This Is It and the related film Michael Jackson's This Is It. She has had recurring roles on 90210, Undercovers, Once Upon a Time as Princess Tiana, Almost Human, Impastor, Secrets & Lies, and Chicago Med. She has a starring role on the ABC police drama The Rookie.
